scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,overlay -c cyan,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter server dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3001/health && pnpm --filter web dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3001/health && pnpm --filter overlay dev"
